str_0_never_the_spool_is_moved_to_help: 0 = never; the spool is moved to the remote at this interval
str_0_the_fastest_but_a_call_split_help: 0: the fastest, but a call split between two windows can be missed.
str_1_a_notification_for_every_help: 1 = a notification for every detection (many messages); 0 = off.
str_1_a_notification_for_the_first_help: 1 = a notification for the first detection of each species each day.
str_1_a_notification_when_a_species_help: 1 = a notification when a species is detected for the first time at the station.
str_1_at_boot_the_network_position_help: 1 = at boot, the network position is compared with the coordinates and the Latest page asks if the station moved; 0 = off.
str_1_clip_spectrograms_without_help: 1 = clip sonograms without axes and labels; 0 = with them.
str_1_detections_are_uploaded_to_help: 1 = detections are uploaded to BirdWeather (needs BIRDWEATHER_ID); 0 = paused, the token is kept.
str_1_every_chosen_day_0_only_the_help: 1 = every chosen day; 0 = only the next one, then off.
str_1_no_update_badge_in_the_menu_help: 1 = no update badge in the menu.
str_1_only_the_top_species_of_each_help: 1 = only the top species of each recording is kept; 0 = every species above its minimum.
str_1_species_the_location_model_help: 1 = species the location model does not expect here go to the Rare channel.
str_1_the_live_audio_goes_through_a_help: 1 = the live audio goes through a dynamics compressor; 0 = off.
str_1_the_live_spectrogram_starts_help: 1 = the live sonogram starts without sound until the viewer unticks Silent (each browser keeps its choice).
str_1_the_pages_only_over_https_the_help: 1 = the pages only over https (the browser warns once per device about the station's own certificate); 0 = http, https only for a moment to read the GPS of a location.
str_1_the_raw_recording_schedule_is_help: 1 = the Raw Recording schedule is on (long unprocessed WAV files beside the analysis).
str_1_the_station_updates_itself_on_help: 1 = the station updates itself on the days and at the time below; 0 = only by hand.
str_1_this_stations_clips_are_help: 1 = this station's clips are contributed to BirdDB-Br; 0 = off.
str_a_masked_link_to_the_detection: A masked link to the detection.
str_a_minimum_probability_of_help: A minimum probability of occurrence at the location of 0.03 means that for a species to be included in this list, it needs to, on average, be seen on at least 3% of historically submitted eBird checklists for your given lat/lon/current week of year.
str_a_new_user_needs_a_password: A new user needs a password.
str_a_photo_of_the_species_attached_help: A photo of the species, attached to the notification
str_a_recording_where_a_human_voice_help: A recording where a human voice is among the top N% of the predictions is dropped.
str_a_reset_link_goes_to_help: A reset link goes by {channel} to the address or group set up for the notifications.
str_a_species_not_detected_for_this_help: A species not detected for this many days is highlighted as rare on the Latest page.
str_a_user_name_is_letters_and_help: A user name is letters and digits, up to 32.
str_activate_birddb_true_the_birddb_help: Activate BirdDB: true = the BirdDB-Br section is shown in {menu:Sharing}; false = hidden.
str_also_applies_to_the_region_rare_help: Also applies to the region-rare alerts.
str_always_protect_the_best_help: Always protect the best detections of each species:
str_analyze_ffmpeg_cpu_memory_usage_help: Analyze ffmpeg CPU/Memory usage with top or htop if necessary.
str_any_species_the_location_model_help: any species the location model does not expect here (in no week: vagrant; not now: out of season) is also sent here, with the reason, once per Repetition limit
str_apprise_notifications_can_be_help: Apprise Notifications can be setup and enabled for 90+ notification services.
str_at_every_boot_the_station_help: At every boot the station compares its approximate network position (public IP geolocation: ipapi.co / ip-api.com) with these coordinates; farther than the location's radius (at least LOCATION_IP_ERROR_KM) every page asks whether to use the new location (coordinates, Brazilian state species list, timezone). Nothing changes without your answer.
str_attaches_the_detections_audio_help: Attaches the detection's audio clip to the notification
str_audio_card_birdnet_mic_help: birdnet_mic = the shared USB microphone (set automatically); another ALSA device from the output of `arecord -L`.
str_audio_format_of_the_saved_clips_help: Audio format of the saved clips: flac, mp3, wav or ogg.
str_audio_loss_discard_help: A dropped detection is not saved, clipped or notified; the analysis log says so. A loss of a few hundredths of a ms is inaudible: 20 ms is the factory limit.
str_audio_loss_help: The recorder loses a little audio when the sound card is not read in time (an "overrun"): every detection keeps how much was lost in its recording.
str_birdweather_catalogues_the_bird_help: BirdWeather catalogues the bird audio and sonogram visualizations so that you can listen to, view, and read about birds throughout the world.
str_birdweather_com_is_a_weather_help: BirdWeather.com is a weather map for bird sounds.
str_both_can_be_set_later_in_help: Both can be left empty and set later in
str_brazilian_state_only_the_birds_help: Brazilian state: only the birds with WikiAves records in the state (CBRO names) plus the model's non-bird classes; built once, then kept as a station list you can edit.
str_channels_recorded_from_the_help: Channels recorded from the sound card: 1 = mono, 2 = stereo.
str_check_the_detections_with_lost_help: Check the detections whose recording lost audio in {menu}, Audio loss filter: listen to them on their sonograms.
str_check_the_values_below_the_help: Check the values below (the location, timezone and state were guessed from the network) and save to start detecting.
str_choose_how_to_recover_help: Choose how the password comes back if you forget it.
str_choose_the_dsnoop_device_if_it_help: Choose the `dsnoop` device if it is available.
str_choosing_another_microphone_help: Recording and the live audio restart for a moment with the chosen microphone.
str_colour_palette_of_the_help: Colour palette of the sonograms: birdnet (Classic), viridis, inferno, ocean, grayscale, soxheat, turbo or roseus.
str_colours_of_the_app_ocean_dark_help: Colours of the app: ocean, dark, forest, blossom, white, red or custom1, custom2…; a location can have its own.
str_colours_of_the_app_shown_at_help: Colours of the app, shown at once; a custom theme can be made later in {menu:Themes}.
str_contrast_gamma_of_the_help: Contrast gamma of the sonograms (0.5–2; 1 = linear).
str_currently_it_supports_over_6_help: Currently it supports over 6,000 species worldwide, giving quite good species coverage for people in most of the world.
str_cycle_and_off_modes_minutes_the_help: Cycle and off modes: minutes the station WiFi stays on when no phone joins it.
str_cycle_mode_the_station_wifi_help: Cycle mode: the station WiFi turns on again every so many minutes.
str_days_of_the_automatic_update_help: Days of the automatic update, comma separated: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday.
str_days_of_the_week_comma_help: Days of the week, comma separated: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday.
str_default_notification_tier_for_help: Default notification tier for species not listed in {menu:Species}:
str_delete_the_saved_settings_the_help: Delete the saved settings "{name}"? The station's settings stay as they are.
str_deletes_the_stations_help: Deletes the saved copy only; the station's settings stay
str_detect_the_brazilian_state_from_help: Detect the Brazilian state from the coordinates
str_detect_the_brazilian_state_the_help: Detect the Brazilian state: the state of the latitude / longitude above (OpenStreetMap online, the IBGE boundaries offline).
str_detections_in_the_latest_list_help: Detections in the Latest list: 10, 25, 50 or 100; each browser may pick another.
str_detections_start_appearing_on_help: Detections start appearing on the Latest in a few minutes.
str_detections_start_tools_help: Detections start appearing on the Latest in a few minutes; Tools and Settings now ask for the user birdsuite and your password.
str_developer_preview_of_the_next_help: Developer preview of the next BirdNET generation, the model of the BirdNET Live app.
str_disk_and_life_cycle_of_the_help: Disk and life cycle of the sounds
str_disk_use_pct_that_starts_the_help: Disk use (%) that starts the purge or the stop (0 = never).
str_do_the_same_for_the_rare_group_help: do the same for the Rare group, then paste both below.
str_each_day_a_species_keeps_its_n_help: Each day, a species keeps its N clips of highest confidence (0 = no limit).
str_each_location_uploads_with_its_help: Each location uploads with its own token; create one BirdWeather station per location, with that location's coordinates.
str_each_name_in_the_title_or_the_help: Each $name in the title or the body is replaced by its value when the notification is sent.
str_each_service_should_be_on_its_help: Each service should be on its own line.
str_empty_no_upload_deposits_stay_help: empty = no upload, deposits stay in the local spool
str_empty_rare_apprise_title_body_help: Empty Rare Apprise/title/body fall back to the Normal ones.
str_empty_this_location_does_not_upload: empty = this location does not upload
str_enable_support_locations_help: Enable support for several locations: 1 = the Loc: picker, the location in the header and lists, the list of locations and New location; 0 = one place, those hidden.
str_enable_support_stations_help: Enable support for several stations: 1 = the station list in the header, {menu:Stations} and Move to station; 0 = one station, those hidden.
str_enables_two_parallel_models_to_help: Enables two parallel models to run simultaneously - use the model comparison ({menu:Model comparison}) to evaluate.
str_end_of_normal_tier_hh_help: End of the quiet hours of the normal tier, HH:MM.
str_end_of_rare_tier_hh_mm_help: End of the quiet hours of the rare tier, HH:MM.
str_end_time_hh_mm_ss_earlier_than_help: End time, HH:MM:SS; earlier than the start = the next day.
str_errors_only_is_recommended_not_help: Errors Only is recommended; not every service uses it.
str_every_detection_keeps_the_help: Every detection keeps the values of its location at the time it was recorded (columns Biome, Ecoregion, Biome_BR, Land_Cover, Built_Up of the exported data).
str_every_page_asks_for_this_login_help: Every page of the station asks for this login; the factory password birdsuite only opens this page, to set your own.
str_every_setting_its_factory_help: Every setting: its factory default (factory_defaults.conf, comes with each update) and the value this station uses. A light yellow field differs from the factory default.
str_example_if_you_own_your_own_help: Example if you own your own domain:
str_factory_password_only_sets_help: The station has no password of its own yet: the factory password only opens the page where you set yours.
str_ffmpeg_frequency_in_hz_moved_help: ffmpeg: frequency in Hz moved down to FREQSHIFT_LO.
str_ffmpeg_frequency_in_hz_that_help: ffmpeg: frequency in Hz that FREQSHIFT_HI is moved to.
str_find_a_group_id_on_the_phone_or_help: Find a group id on the phone or the computer:
str_find_the_stations_network_help: Find the station's network position now and put it in Latitude / Longitude
str_floor_of_the_spectrogram_colour_help: Floor of the sonogram colour scale in dB (-120 to -40; lower = fainter sounds show).
str_for_privacy_with_v3_0_turn_on_help: For privacy with V3.0, turn on Shadow mode with BirdNET V2.4.
str_freqshift_base_help: Sounds below this frequency in Hz (wind, traffic, hum) are cut before the lowering, on the live audio and the lowered clips; 0 = nothing is cut.
str_get_coordinates_with_auto_help: Get coordinates with Auto Locate Now or on latlong.net; detections are stamped with the timezone below.
str_google_geolocation_api_key_help: Google Geolocation API key (optional) to locate the station by the Wi-Fi around it; empty = BeaconDB, then the IP.
str_height_of_the_live_spectrogram_help: Height of the live sonogram, in % of the page height.
str_higher_a_shorter_species_list_help: Higher: a shorter species list for the place and the week, fewer species that do not occur here, but vagrants and out-of-season species are cut.
str_higher_fewer_detections_and_help: Higher: fewer detections and fewer false positives, but quiet or distant birds are missed.
str_higher_uncertain_sounds_get_a_help: Higher: uncertain sounds get a higher confidence, so more of them pass Min. Conf. (more detections, more false positives).
str_how_far_off_the_network_ip_help: How far off the network (IP) position can be, in km; the boot check never asks below this.
str_how_the_latest_page_opens_on_a_help: How the Latest page opens on a wide screen: simple, list (Full) or spectrogram (sonogram cards); a phone always opens simple.
str_how_will_you_recover_it: How will you recover it if you forget it?
str_i_will_use_more_than_one_help: I will use more than one BirdSuite station
str_if_you_place_an_rtsp_stream_url_help: If you place an RTSP stream URL here, BirdSuite will use that as its audio source.
str_if_you_want_your_installation_help: If you want your installation to respond to an IP address, place that here, but be sure to indicate "http://".
str_if_youd_please_click_apply_help: If you would like to try this minimum probability of occurrence at the location and see which species make it onto the list, click Apply at the end of the Models section to install the matching label file, then come back here to use the Species List Tester.
str_if_youd_you_can_use_this_help: If you'd like to tinker with this minimum probability of occurrence at the location and see which species make it onto the list, you can use this tool:
str_in_depth_technical_write_up_on_help: In-depth technical write-up on the models: here
str_in_use_none_the_station_answers_help: In use: none, the station answers on every address: {list}
str_interface_language_empty_follow_help: Interface language; empty = follow DATABASE_LANG when available, else English.
str_iphone_the_hotspot_name_is_short_hel: iPhone: the hotspot name is the phone's name.
str_km_from_filled_in_above_help: {where}: {km} km from the saved coordinates; filled in above, save to keep it
str_lan_trust_everyone: every page asks for the login
str_lan_trust_help: Your network is any private network: the LAN, the station WiFi, the VPN. The settings, the log, the terminal, the files, the live audio and the database always ask, and a device outside these networks asks for everything.
str_lan_trust_household: only my household: viewing, reviews and lists without the login
str_latitude_must_be_a_number_help: Latitude must be a number between -90 and 90
str_leave_both_current_password_help: Leave both empty to keep the current password.
str_leave_the_password_empty_to_help: Leave the password empty to keep the current one; tick Remove the password to open the station without login.
str_loaded_settings_analysis_help: {name} loaded ({n} settings). Analysis settings apply from the next recording; a few after a restart in System Controls.
str_longitude_must_be_a_number_help: Longitude must be a number between -180 and 180
str_low_prob_filter_location_help: Unlikely here filter: location probability below this % (5–95).
str_lower_a_longer_list_vagrants_help: Lower: a longer list, vagrants pass, and more errors from unlikely species.
str_lower_more_detections_and_more_help: Lower: more detections, and more errors to review.
str_make_sure_that_the_latitude_and_help: Make sure that the Latitude and Longitude match what is in your BirdSuite configuration.
str_maximum_clips_per_species_per_day: Maximum clips per species per day:
str_microphone_gain_default_help: The default is the maximum the card allows.
str_microphone_gain_help: More gain: quieter, more distant birds are heard, but there is more noise.
str_min_conf_of_the_second_model_0_help: Min. Conf. of the second model (0.01–0.99).
str_min_conf_the_lowest_score_a_help: Min. Conf.: the lowest score a detection needs to be kept (0.01–0.99).
str_min_prob_of_the_second_models_help: Min. Prob. of the second model's location filter (0.0005–0.99).
str_min_prob_species_the_location_help: Min. Prob.: species the location model expects here this week below this probability are left out (0.0005–0.99).
str_minimum_confidence_number_help: Minimum confidence (Min. Conf.) as a number
str_minimum_confidence_percentage_help: Minimum confidence (Min. Conf.) as a percentage
str_minimum_probability_at_the_location_: Minimum probability of occurrence at the location (Min. Prob.)
Minimum probability of occurrence at the location = the "Min. Prob." column of the Models table above.
str_minimum_seconds_between_two_help: Minimum seconds between two notifications of the same species (0 = no limit).
str_minutes_after_the_last_phone_help: Minutes after the last phone left before the station WiFi turns off (cycle and off modes, Bluetooth, the page).
str_minutes_between_uploads_to_the_help: Minutes between uploads to the BirdDB-Br repository (0 = never).
str_moment_s_with_a_human_voice_help: {n} moment(s) with a human voice dropped in the last 24 h
str_more_more_windows_per_recording_help: More: more windows per recording, short calls caught more often, the same song counted more times, more processor load.
str_moved_recording_settings_help: The recording length and the length and format of the clips are in {model}.
str_ms_lost_inside_the_detection: ms lost inside the detection's own seconds
str_multiple_streams_are_allowed_help: Multiple streams are allowed but may have a impact on rPi performance.
str_multiples_of_3_are_recommended_help: Multiples of 3 are recommended, as BirdNET analyzes in 3-second chunks.
str_name_and_the_six_colours_shown_help: name and the six colours (shown at once):
str_names_can_be_changed_later_in_help: names can be changed later in {menu:Stations} and {menu:Locations}
str_never_in_the_notification_title_help: Never in the notification title or body.
str_no_leaves_the_coordinates_filled_in_: No leaves the coordinates filled in, to check them and save.
str_no_normal_notifications_in_this_help: no Normal notifications in this window (it may cross midnight, e.g. 22:00 to 06:00); empty = always notify
str_no_rare_notifications_in_this_help: no Rare notifications in this window (it may cross midnight, e.g. 22:00 to 06:00); empty = always notify
str_no_reset_channel_help: No e-mail or Telegram was chosen to recover the password. Put the file reset-web-password on the card's boot partition and start the station: the password goes back to the factory one (birdsuite).
str_no_species_names_for_that_language: No species names for that language
str_no_update_badge_in_the_menu: No update badge in the menu
str_none_every_species_the_models_help: None: every species the model's location filter allows for this place and week; use it outside Brazil or to detect species not yet registered in your area.
str_not_active_birdnet_plus_v3_has_help: not active: BirdNET+ V3 has no human voice class; turn on Shadow mode with BirdNET V2.4 in {menu} to drop human voices
str_not_listed_what_the_help: Not listed: what the installation sets for this station (name, coordinates, user, folders, passwords, tokens).
str_not_saved_the_station_did_not_help: Not saved: the station did not answer
str_not_set_on_this_station_the_help: Not set on this station: the default applies
str_note_by_using_your_birdweather_help: NOTE: by using your BirdWeather Token, you are consenting to sharing your soundscapes and detections with BirdWeather
str_notification_of_the_species_help: Notification of the species: Normal, Muted (never notified) or Rare (Rare channel); the same setting as in {menu:Species}
str_notify_each_infrequent_species_help: Notify each infrequent species (up to 5 detections in the last 7 days)
str_notify_each_species_first_help: Notify each species first detection of the day
str_now_conf_help: Now page: minimum confidence in % of a detection shown (10 to 90); each browser may pick another.
str_now_page_the_background_of_test_help: Now page: the background of Test / Playback when it has none of its own (a factory background for tests); All never sets it.
str_now_page_the_picture_that_fills_help: Now page: the picture that fills the background of the bird pictures where a location has none of its own (not Test / Playback), the absolute path of an image file in the station user's home (empty = none); the picture icon beside Size sets or clears the background of the location shown.

str_number_of_files_to_keep_for_help: Number of files to keep for each species:

str_once_thats_done_you_can_go_to_help: Once that's done, you can go to:

str_only_for_the_model_selected_above: Only for the model selected above
str_only_in_the_apprise_help: Only in the Apprise Configuration boxes
str_only_useful_for_services_that_help: Only useful for services that support Markdown (e.g. Discord).
str_open_station_warning: Open station: anyone who reaches it can change everything, the terminal included.
str_open_web_telegram_org_a_in_the_help: open web.telegram.org/a in the browser and sign in (the code arrives in the Telegram app);
str_other_secret_values_from_the_help: Other secret values from the station's private token store (apprise-tokens.txt)
str_other_ways_back_help: Other ways back: the file reset-web-password on the card's boot partition (the factory password at the next start), or sudo birdsuite-root webpassword-reset on the console.
str_outside_the_recent_days_each_help: Outside the recent days, each species keeps its N best clips in total (0 = no limit).
str_period_searched_by_the_latest_help: Period searched by the Latest filters and search: today, 7d or all.
str_phone_hotspot_not_saved: The phone hotspot was not saved: {error}. Set it in {menu:Network}.
str_pick_the_place_on_a_map_a_click_help: Pick the place on a map: a click (or dragging the pin) fills latitude and longitude
str_preview_save_the_custom_theme_help: Preview: save the custom theme, then Apply.
str_privacy_a_recording_where_a_help: Privacy: a recording where a human voice is among the top N% of the predictions is dropped (0–3; 0 = off).
str_probability_of_prob_help: Probability of occurrence of the species at the location this week (Prob.)
str_protect_the_clips_of_the_last_help: Protect the clips of the last (days):
str_purge_the_audio_of_ignored_help: Purge the audio of Ignored detections after (days):
str_put_every_setting_back_to_its_help: Put EVERY setting back to its default? (Save the current settings first if you want to keep them.)
str_range_of_the_colour_scale_above_help: Range of the colour scale above the floor, in dB (30–120).
str_recovery_sdcard: I can reach the SD card (the file reset-web-password)
str_recovery_sdcard_only_help: Password recovery: SD card only. A reset link needs the e-mail or Telegram notifications.
str_references_biome_ecoregion_and_help: References: biome, ecoregion and land cover
str_repetition_limit_seconds_before_help: Repetition limit: seconds before the same species notifies again:
str_run_the_first_run_help: The set-up questions of a new station, in six steps: answer them now if you skipped them at the first visit. Only the settings still at their factory value change.
str_save_as_a_new_custom_theme: Save as a new custom theme
str_save_the_settings_in_use_as: Save the settings in use as
str_saved_names_shown_in_the_new_languag: Saved: the names are shown in the new language.
str_seconds_after_a_start_up_before_help: Seconds after a start-up before the station WiFi may turn on (the known networks first).
str_seconds_of_each_recorded_and_help: Seconds of each recorded and analysed file (3–60).
str_seconds_of_each_saved_detection_help: Seconds of each saved detection clip (3 to RECORDING_LENGTH).
str_seconds_the_3_s_analysis_help: Seconds the 3 s analysis windows overlap (0–2.9; more = fewer missed calls, more CPU).
str_seconds_without_any_network_help: Seconds without any network (cable, WiFi or phone hotspot gone) before the station WiFi turns on.
str_secrets_never_appear_on_this_page: Secrets never appear on this page.
str_selection_the_row_under_the_help: Selection: the row under the mouse, the page you are on (the menu item under the mouse in a light shade)
str_set_a_species_to_muted_to_help: Set a species to Muted to silence it;
str_set_channels_to_the_number_of_help: Set Channels to the number of channels supported by your sound card.
str_set_extraction_length_to_help: Set Extraction Length to something less than your Recording Length.

str_set_up_and_test_channel_first_help: Set up {channel} and confirm its test first ({menu}), or choose the SD card.

str_settings_that_differ_from_the_help: Settings that differ from the factory default

str_start_of_rare_tier_hh_help: Start of the quiet hours of the rare tier, HH:MM (empty = none).
str_station_list_only_the_species_help: Station list: only the species of that list; edit, save and load lists in {menu:Allowed species}.
str_station_wifi_password_not_saved: The station WiFi password was not saved: {error}. Set it in {menu:Network}.
str_stations_around_the_world_help: Stations around the world supply audio and video streams to BirdWeather where they are then analyzed by BirdNET and compared to eBird Grid data.
str_still_the_change_it_in_help: still the factory password: change it in {menu}
str_swap_the_official_and_the_help: Swap the official and the shadow model (each keeps its own minimum confidence, sensitivity and minimum probability of occurrence at the location)?
str_table_cells_boxes_and_page_buttons: Table cells, boxes and page buttons
str_tap_the_group_the_address_ends_help: tap the group: the address ends in #-100…, and that number, with the minus sign, is the id;
str_tap_to_start_the_live_sound: Tap to start the live sound.
str_the_3_second_analysis_windows_help: The 3-second analysis windows overlap by this many seconds.
str_the_analysis_phone_open_help: The analysis settings box (Param.) of the Latest page on a phone: open or closed.
str_the_analysis_wider_screen_help: The analysis settings box (Param.) of the Latest page on a wider screen: open or closed.
str_the_audio_of_ignored_detections_help: The audio of Ignored detections (Human, Noise, Ignore) is deleted N days later; the detections keep counting (0 = only by hand).
str_the_biome_and_ecoregion_come_help: The biome and ecoregion come from the coordinates, offline; the land cover is looked up online when the location is saved.
str_the_birdnet_model_that_analyses_help: The BirdNET model that analyses the audio ({menu:Model}).
str_the_birdnet_plus_v3_model_has_help: The BirdNET+ V3 model has no human voice class!
str_the_birdsuite_url_is_how_the_help: The BirdSuite URL is how the main page will be reached.
str_the_bot_and_the_groups_set_in_help: The bot and the groups set in {menu:Telegram}
str_the_clips_of_the_last_n_days_help: The clips of the last N days are left out of the per-species limit (0 = no per-species limit).
str_the_devices_gps_position_help: The device's GPS position; without it the approximate network position (city level)
str_the_e_mail_recipient_is_set_in_help: The e-mail recipient is set in {email}.
str_the_filter_phone_open_2_help: The filter panel of the Latest page when it opens on a phone: open or closed.
str_the_filter_phone_open_help: The filter line of {menu:By Hour} and By Week when they open on a phone: open or closed.
str_the_filter_wider_screen_2_help: The filter panel of the Latest page when it opens on a wider screen: open or closed.
str_the_filter_wider_screen_help: The filter line of {menu:By Hour} and By Week when they open on a wider screen: open or closed.
str_the_login_protects_the_pages_of_help: The login is asked on every page opened from another device, on the live audio and on every change; the station's own calls do not log in.
str_the_main_user_stays_help: The login above stays: change its name and password above.
str_the_microphone_could_not_be_changed: The microphone could not be changed.
str_the_microphone_gain_could_not_be_set: The microphone gain could not be set.
str_the_n_best_clips_of_each_help: The N best clips of each species are never deleted, besides the locked, Yes and Review later ones (0 = all protected).
str_the_names_follow_the_columns_of_help: The names follow the columns of the app: Conf., Min. Conf., Manual Conf., Prob., Min. Prob.
str_the_password_may_contain_help: The password may contain letters, digits and ! @ # % ^ & * ( ) - _ = + [ ] { } . , : ? ~ /
str_the_pis_processing_load_goes_up_help: The Pi's processing load goes up: test it first (two models on every recording).
str_the_reason_a_notification_was_sent: The reason a notification was sent
str_the_recording_stops_for_a_help: The recording stops for a moment, the new coordinates are saved and the recording starts again.
str_the_reset_link_could_not_be_sent_hel: The reset link could not be sent: check the channel on its page, or use the card's file reset-web-password.
str_the_reset_link_is_no_longer_help: This reset link is no longer valid (used, or older than 15 minutes). Ask for a new one.
str_the_reset_link_was_sent_help: The reset link was sent by {channel}. It works once, for 15 minutes.
str_the_reset_only_from_your_network_hel: A forgotten password is reset only from your own network (the LAN, the station WiFi, the VPN).
str_the_second_model_its_detections_help: The second model; its detections go to birds_shadow.db.
str_the_species_manual_confidence_help: The species' manual confidence (Manual Conf.), or none
str_the_station_restarts_its_help: The station restarts its services with the new settings.
str_the_station_still_has_the_help: The station still has the factory password birdsuite: set your own here.
str_the_station_wifi_password_is_not_hel: The station WiFi password goes on the QR label: it must not be the web password.
str_the_station_wifi_ssid_its_password_h: The station's own WiFi is {ssid}; its password goes on the QR label, 8 to 63 characters, never the web password.
str_the_station_wifi_when_the_help: The station WiFi when the station has no network: always (on until a known network is back), cycle (on every few minutes for a while) or off (only after start-up, then the WiFi antenna off).
str_the_stations_saving_takes_help: The station's clock is not confirmed (no internet): saving takes the time of this device ({time}).
str_the_telegram_bot_and_groups_are_help: The Telegram bot and groups are set in {telegram}.
str_the_user_name_is_it_can_be_help: The user name is {user} (it can be changed in {menu:Access}).
str_the_web_password_is_changed_help: The web password is changed. Log in with it.
str_this_has_generally_worse_help: This has generally worse performance than the newer models but is kept as a legacy option.
str_this_is_the_birdnet_analyzer_help: This is the BirdNET-Analyzer model, the most advanced BirdNET model to date.
str_this_is_the_birdnet_lite_model_help: This is the BirdNET-Lite model, with bird sound recognition for more than 6,000 species worldwide.
str_this_station_will_be_used_at_help: This station will be used at more than one location (home, farm, trips)
str_this_stations_user_and_hostname_help: This station's user and hostname, e.g. {example}
str_this_user_may_not_do_this_help: The user {user} may not do this. Log in as another user (Switch user, at the foot of the menu).
str_this_value_is_used_by_the_model_help: This value is used by the model to constrain the list of possible species that it will try to detect, given the minimum occurrence frequency.
str_three_reset_links_this_hour_help: Three reset links were already asked this hour. Try again later.
str_thresholds_are_not_comparable_help: Thresholds are NOT comparable between generations.
str_tier_of_a_species_without_its_help: Tier of a species without its own: muted (never notified), normal or rare (Rare channel).
str_time_of_the_automatic_update_hh_help: Time of the automatic update, HH:MM, local time.
str_title_of_a_normal_notification_help: Title of a normal notification; variables such as $common_name, $conf_pct, $date, $time ({menu:What and when}).
str_title_of_a_rare_channel_help: Title of a Rare channel notification; the same variables.
str_to_notify_only_selected_species_help: To notify ONLY selected species, set the default tier above to None (muted) and mark the wanted species Normal or Rare.
str_to_remove_all_and_use_the_help: To remove all and use the soundcard again, just delete the RTSP entries and click Save at the bottom.
str_to_request_a_birdweather_token_help: To request a BirdWeather Token, you'll first need to create an account:
str_token1_token20_placeholders_help: $token1..$token20 placeholders resolve from the station's private apprise-tokens.txt
str_token1_token20_secrets_help: $token1..$token20 placeholders resolve from the station's private apprise-tokens.txt; secrets never appear here
str_uncommon_filter_species_help: Uncommon filter: species detected at most this many times since yesterday.
str_unticked_the_controls_for_help: Unticked, the controls for several locations or stations stay hidden; switch them on later in {menu:All settings}.
str_update_the_location_with_this_gps_po: Update the location {name} with this GPS position (± {m} m)?
str_users_help: Each user logs in with its own name and password; the role says what it may change, the level what its menu shows.
str_v2_4_has_human_voice_detection_help: V2.4 has human voice detection and then drops those moments of the official detections too.
str_values_filled_in_above_save_the_help: Values filled in above: save the settings to apply them.
str_web_login_off_help: Off: nobody logs in and no login dialog appears anywhere, the terminal and the files included. The password set is kept for when it is turned on again.
str_web_login_on_needs_a_password_help: Web login On needs a password of the station's own: type one, or choose Off (open station).
str_when_a_normal_species_is_notified: When a Normal species is notified
str_when_more_than_one_applies_one_help: When more than one applies, one message goes out with every reason.
str_when_you_update_the_url_below_help: When you update the URL below, the web server will reload, so be sure to wait at least 30 seconds and then go to your new URL.
str_which_rtsp_stream_the_live_help: Which RTSP stream the live audio plays: 0 = the first, 1 = the second…
str_with_a_token_the_recordings_help: With a token, every recording with detections is uploaded to BirdWeather; {menu:Sharing} switches it off.
str_with_birdnet_plus_v3_it_works_help: With BirdNET+ V3 it works through the shadow model (on): its human voice detection drops those moments of the official detections too.
str_with_more_than_one_station_help: With more than one station: Export the list here and Import it on each of the other stations, so every one can switch to all the others (and back).
str_with_this_stations_settings_no_help: With this station's settings that differ from the factory ones (no password, token, coordinate or name)
str_wiz_alerts_first: The first detection of each species each day
str_wiz_alerts_new: A species heard for the first time, and the rare ones
str_wiz_alerts_setup_after_help: Telegram or e-mail is set up right after saving, on its own page.
str_wiz_be_told_about_birds: Do you want to be told about birds?
str_wiz_make_a_sound_help: Make a sound near the microphone: it shows in the live sonogram below within a few seconds.
str_wiz_run_field_offline: Outdoors with no network at all
str_wiz_species_names_follow_help: The species names follow the interface language; Portuguese (Brazil) uses the CBRO names.
str_wiz_use_birder: I am a birder: I review the detections, keep lists and send to eBird
str_wiz_use_home: See and hear the birds of my home or garden
str_wiz_use_research: Research or field work: several places or several stations
str_write_the_saved_settings_over_help: Write the saved settings "{name}" over the station's? (Save the current ones first if you want to keep them.)
str_writes_the_chosen_settings_over_help: Writes the chosen settings over the station's (asks first)
